articles.headline: At NATO summit in Turkey, Trump says he believes ceasefire with Iran is 'over'
articles.summary: President Trump said he believes the current ceasefire with Iran is over following an exchange of attacks between the U.S. and Iran in the latest escalation straining the agreement to end the war.
articles._summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan welcomes President Trump upon his arrival at Etimesgut Air Base near Ankara, Turkey, on July 7 before attending the NATO summit. Abdullah Guclu/AFP via Getty Images hide caption President Trump said Wednesday he believes the current ceasefire with Iran is over after an exchange of attacks between the U.S. and Iran, the latest escalation straining the agreement to end the war. "I think it's over. I don't want to deal with them anymore. They're scum," Trump told reporters in Ankara, where he is attending the NATO summit. He called the Iranian leaders "vicious, violent people." "If they had a nuclear weapon, they'd use it," he added. Trump, however, did not rule out talks continuing to permanently end the war with Iran. He said the top U.S. negotiators, Steve Witkoff and his son-in-law Jared Kushner, want to negotiate.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普在土耳其举行的北约峰会上表示，他相信与伊朗的停火已经“结束”
articles._zh_summary: 土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安于 7 月 7 日在出席北约峰会之前抵达土耳其安卡拉附近的埃泰姆斯古特空军基地，欢迎特朗普总统。阿卜杜拉·古克卢/法新社来自盖蒂图片社 隐藏标题 特朗普总统周三表示，在美国和伊朗之间相互攻击之后，他认为目前与伊朗的停火已经结束，最新的升级使结束战争的协议变得紧张。 “我认为一切都结束了。我不想再和他们打交道了。他们是人渣，”特朗普在安卡拉出席北约峰会时对记者说。他称伊朗领导人是“恶毒、暴力的人”。 “如果他们拥有核武器，他们就会使用它，”他补充道。然而，特朗普并不排除继续进行永久结束与伊朗战争的谈判。他说，美国最高谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和他的女婿贾里德·库什纳希望进行谈判。
